name: Translate
description: Translate messages with Google Translate, DeepL or Kagi.
summary: Translate messages (shown under them) and, optionally, your own before sending, with Google, DeepL or Kagi

settings.label: Received input
settings.description: Language incoming messages are translated from

settings.label: Received output
settings.description: Language incoming messages are translated to

settings.label: Sent input
settings.description: Language your messages are translated from

settings.label: Sent output
settings.description: Language your messages are translated to

settings.label: DeepL API Key
settings.description: Your DeepL API key (from deepl.com/your-account). Only used with DeepL; kept in the system keychain

settings.label: Kagi Session
settings.description: Your Kagi session token (from kagi.com/settings?p=user_details). Only used with Kagi; kept in the system keychain

settings.label: Auto Translate
settings.description: Automatically translate your messages before sending. You can also Shift+click or right-click the translate button to toggle this

settings.label: Show auto translate tooltip
settings.description: Show a tooltip on the chat bar button when a message is auto-translated

notes: A message's hover bar has upstream's Translate button (and its right-click menu has Translate too); the translation is shown under it after the translate icon. "Translate" in a message's menu shows the translation under it ("translated from X - Dismiss"). The chat bar button opens the languages window (searchable lists for the received and sent languages, and Auto Translate); Shift+click or right-click toggles auto-translate, with upstream's notice the first time. With auto-translate on, a message waits in the locked message box until it is translated, with "Auto Translate Enabled" over the button for two seconds. Google needs no key; DeepL (free or pro, falling back to Google when the quota runs out) and Kagi take an API key or session token, which Qord keeps in the system keychain instead of the settings file. The settings page has upstream's "Customize translation languages & Auto-Translate" button, which opens the languages window, and shows the DeepL key only while DeepL is chosen and the Kagi session only while Kagi is. A message auto-translation fails on is sent as written, as upstream does.
